question: Using the consistency rule that an investor's profile segment should appear in at least one of their holding segments, which investors violate this rule?

            SELECT DISTINCT investor_id, segment

        )
        SELECT p.investor_id, p.investor_name, p.segment AS profile_segment
        FROM ATOM_ENTITY_INVESTOR_PROFILE_001 p
        LEFT JOIN investor_segments s
          ON s.investor_id = p.investor_id
         AND s.segment = p.segment
        WHERE p.segment IS NOT NULL AND TRIM(p.segment) <> ''
          AND s.investor_id IS NULL;

question: Using the consistency rule that an investor's profile category should appear in at least one of their holding categories, which investors violate this rule?
sql_query:
WITH investor_categories AS (
            SELECT DISTINCT investor_id, category
            FROM ATOM_ENTITY_PORTFOLIO_HOLDING_001
            WHERE category IS NOT NULL AND TRIM(category) <> ''
        )
        SELECT p.investor_id, p.investor_name, p.category AS profile_category
        FROM ATOM_ENTITY_INVESTOR_PROFILE_001 p
        LEFT JOIN investor_categories c
          ON c.investor_id = p.investor_id
         AND c.category = p.category
        WHERE p.category IS NOT NULL AND TRIM(p.category) <> ''
          AND c.investor_id IS NULL;

question: For each profile segment, how many investors have at least one holding with the same segment?
sql_query:
WITH investor_segments AS (
            SELECT DISTINCT investor_id, segment
            FROM ATOM_ENTITY_PORTFOLIO_HOLDING_001
            WHERE segment IS NOT NULL AND TRIM(segment) <> ''
        )
        SELECT p.segment AS profile_segment, COUNT(DISTINCT p.investor_id) AS investor_count
        FROM ATOM_ENTITY_INVESTOR_PROFILE_001 p
        JOIN investor_segments o ON o.investor_id = p.investor_id
        WHERE p.segment IS NOT NULL AND TRIM(p.segment) <> ''
          AND o.segment = p.segment
        GROUP BY p.segment;
sql_reason: Distinct-segment CTE joined and COUNT(DISTINCT investor_id) grouped by segment avoids fan-out.

question: How many distinct investors have a profile category that is represented by at least one holding category versus not represented by any holding category?
sql_query:
WITH investor_categories AS (
            SELECT DISTINCT investor_id, category
            FROM ATOM_ENTITY_PORTFOLIO_HOLDING_001
            WHERE category IS NOT NULL AND TRIM(category) <> ''
        )
        SELECT CASE
                 WHEN c.investor_id IS NOT NULL
                 THEN 'profile_category_represented'
                 ELSE 'profile_category_not_represented'
               END AS consistency_status,
               COUNT(DISTINCT p.investor_id) AS investor_count
        FROM ATOM_ENTITY_INVESTOR_PROFILE_001 p
        LEFT JOIN investor_categories c
          ON c.investor_id = p.investor_id
         AND c.category = p.category
        WHERE p.category IS NOT NULL AND TRIM(p.category) <> ''
        GROUP BY consistency_status;
sql_reason: LEFT JOIN to distinct-category CTE with CASE and COUNT(DISTINCT investor_id) correctly partitions investors.

question: How do profile category counts compare with holding category counts for category values appearing in either table?
sql_query:
WITH profile_counts AS (
            SELECT category, COUNT(*) AS profile_count
            FROM ATOM_ENTITY_INVESTOR_PROFILE_001
            GROUP BY category
        ),
        holding_counts AS (
            SELECT category, COUNT(*) AS holding_count
            FROM ATOM_ENTITY_PORTFOLIO_HOLDING_001
            GROUP BY category
        ),
        categories AS (
            SELECT category FROM profile_counts
            UNION
            SELECT category FROM holding_counts
        )
        SELECT c.category,
               COALESCE(p.profile_count, 0) AS profile_count,
               COALESCE(h.holding_count, 0) AS holding_count
        FROM categories c
        LEFT JOIN profile_counts p ON p.category IS c.category
        LEFT JOIN holding_counts h ON h.category IS c.category;
sql_reason: Pre-aggregated CTEs full-outer-joined via UNION-of-keys with COALESCE correctly compare counts including NULLs.
